G1_unambiguity.justification: The definition of market-linked precisely requires connectivity of the selected assets, so the required fund and its cost are unambiguous.

G2_completeness.justification: All necessary constraints, input formats, bounds, costs, and output requirements are explicitly provided.

G3_faithfulness.justification: Because the contracts form a connected graph with n−1 edges, selecting a market-linked asset subset containing the mandatory assets has exactly the same minimum cost as connecting those sites in the original tree.

G4_naturalness.justification: The financial terminology is coherent and readable, though the metaphor is somewhat contrived for a standard tree-connectivity problem.
